def expand({{llm_call}}, {{query}}, {{n}}=4):
    p = f"Rewrite this query in {{{n}}} different ways. One per line. Query: {{{query}}}"
    out = {{llm_call}}(p)
    return [{{query}}] + [l.strip("- 0123456789.").strip() for l in out.splitlines() if l.strip()]
summary_zh: 請 LLM 生 N 個查詢變體加上原 query 一起檢索
